integrity: Relative Grassmannian chart equations and exact local maps, three Jacobians, and Chern number are printed and checked; the global classification proves geometric support finiteness in all characteristics and the finite-flat isomorphism. Exact finite-field enumeration is corroboration, not a proof for all fields.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the primitive Cayley cubic over the integers; the classical nine reduced lines and the smooth-cubic degree-27 enumerative formula are antecedents, not claimed new. Historical originality is provisional against uninspected historical sources on Fano degenerations. Independent scientific audit not yet performed.
title: The integral 27-line Hilbert scheme of the four-nodal Cayley cubic
